- Using t instead of 2t.
- Not applying joint efficiency.

steps.title: Concept
steps.body: Hot work permit: identify hazard → gas test → isolate/remove flammables → fire watch and extinguisher → issue permit → work → inspect after.

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Example: LEL reading of 0% before arc starts; fire watch for 30 minutes after.

steps.title: Common mistakes
steps.body:
- Permit without gas test.
- No fire watch.

scenes.text: Two identical presses each give 90 dB at the operator.

steps.title: Concept
steps.body: Sound levels add on an energy basis: **L = 10 log10 Σ 10^(Li/10)**. Doubling identical sources adds about 3 dB.

steps.title: Common mistakes
steps.body:
- Adding dB arithmetically (180 dB).
- Ignoring exposure time.

steps.title: Concept
steps.body: Fixed guards first; interlocked movable guards where access is needed; two-hand controls and light curtains for presses; emergency stop is not a substitute for guarding.

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Example: a lathe chuck guard interlocked so spindle cannot start when open.

steps.title: Common mistakes
steps.body:
- Bypassing interlocks.
- Loose clothing near rotating parts.

steps.title: Concept
steps.body: Risk factors: load, posture, frequency, distance, grip. Reduce by mechanical aids, smaller loads, better layout, training and job rotation.

steps.title: Worked example

steps.title: Common mistakes

- Ignoring repetition.
